'''Etha Naru''' was a [[Professor/Legends|professor]]. For a time, she had worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], before being thought to be [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops. In fact, she went on to work for the Galactic Empire as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]. Leaving behind her rebel past, and a daughter, she began researching for the Empire and stumbled upon a technique for mass-manufacturing [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].

Word of her discovery reached a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives who were concerned of the implications of the discovery. They traced her to a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] where Naru was attending a secret conference of Imperial scientists. By chance, one of the rebel operatives was Naru's daughter, who'd always believed her mother had killed by the Imperials. The operatives continuing their pursuit of Naru, leading them to to the fortress [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tikath]].

==Behind the scenes==
Etha Naru was used to illustrate how to integrate a big twist into a roleplaying game. As such, the resolution of her story was left unclear.
